items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩、胸腺上皮细胞丢失和Treg发育及功能受损，提示胸腺可能是ALS免疫失调的重要源头。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫机制从外周神经炎症前移到中枢免疫器官胸腺，提出胸腺退化可能是Treg功能缺陷的上游原因。对于关注ALS免疫调节治疗的研究者，这提示靶向胸腺功能或Treg发育通路可能成为新的干预方向，也强调了在ALS中评估中枢免疫耐受状态的重要性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS期间调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能实验分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化的各个阶段和抑制能力。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质区域，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺作为ALS免疫失调的中枢靶器官，为理解Treg功能障碍提供了上游机制，并提示了潜在的转化干预靶点。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 弥合肌萎缩侧索硬化症临床试验的可信度差距
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇发表于《Neurology》的观点文章，指出ALS早期和中期临床试验常被用来宣称疗效，但这些结果大多未能在3期试验中重现，形成了“临床试验可信度差距”。作者将原因归咎于产业界与学术界激励错位所催生的“临床试验工业复合体”，并列举了常见谬误：错误前提下的结局比较、生物标志物误用、设计与目标不匹配、选择性报告、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签数据、对不确定结果的乐观包装。作者呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与假设检验、审慎描述结果、严格分流2期项目，并推动科学怀疑和方法学严谨的文化转变。
items.insight: 这篇观点文章直接触及ALS试验领域长期存在的结构性问题：2期信号被过度解读为疗效证据，进而影响3期设计和患者预期。对ALS研究者而言，它提醒在解读NfL等生物标志物、开放标签扩展数据和事后分析时保持方法学警惕，并强调2期到3期的决策需要更严格的分流标准。该文虽不提供新数据，但为试验设计、结果报告和领域文化提供了值得对照的批判性框架。

items.title: Herbal nanoparticles in the treatment of neurodegeneration: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, are characterized by progressive neuronal loss involving multiple pathological mechanisms, including protein aggregation, oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and mitochondrial dysfunction. Although conventional therapies provide symptomatic relief, they fail to halt disease progression and are limited by poor blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration, off-target effects, and systemic toxicity. Likewise, several herbal bioactives, such as curcumin, resveratrol, quercetin, and epigallocatechin gallate, exhibit promising neuroprotective properties but suffer from poor aqueous solubility, low oral bioavailability, rapid metabolism, and inadequate brain delivery. Nanotechnology-based delivery systems have emerged as a promising approach to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations by enhancing stability, controlled release, BBB transport, and brain accumulation of herbal therapeutics. This review critically summarizes recent advances in herbal nanoformulations, emphasizing disease-specific molecular targets, BBB-targeting strategies, comparative nanocarrier systems, pharmacokinetic optimization, intracellular trafficking, and translational challenges. Unlike previous reviews, it integrates recent evidence on nanotoxicology, manufacturing scalability, quality control, regulatory considerations, and emerging technologies, including biomimetic nanoparticles and extracellular vesicles. Despite encouraging preclinical outcomes, clinical evidence remains limited, and no herbal nanoformulation has yet demonstrated definitive efficacy or received regulatory approval for neurodegenerative diseases. Future clinical translation will require standardized formulations, rigorous safety evaluation, and well-designed clinical trials. Unlike previous reviews that primarily summarize individual nanocarrier systems or herbal therapeutics, the present review provides a comprehensive and critical synthesis of the current evidence by integrating disease-specific molecular mechanisms, herbal bioactives, nanocarrier design strategies, blood-brain barrier transport mechanisms, intracellular trafficking, pharmacokinetic considerations, translational barriers, regulatory challenges, clinical evidence, and emerging technologies. Furthermore, the review identifies major knowledge gaps and future research priorities to facilitate the successful clinical translation of herbal nanoformulations for neurodegenerative disorders. The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8.
items.titleZh: 草药纳米颗粒治疗神经退行性疾病：从分子机制到治疗转化
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了草药来源的生物活性分子（如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素、EGCG）通过纳米递送系统治疗神经退行性疾病（含ALS）的研究进展。文章重点讨论了如何利用纳米载体改善这些分子的溶解度、稳定性、血脑屏障穿透和脑内蓄积，并覆盖了疾病相关分子靶点、纳米载体设计、药代动力学、纳米毒理、生产放大、质控和监管等转化环节。作者明确指出：目前临床前数据虽多，但临床证据有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中证实疗效或获批。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把“草药活性分子+纳米递送”这一相对分散的领域，按疾病机制、BBB转运、细胞内转运和转化瓶颈做了系统整合。ALS治疗长期受限于血脑屏障和药物递送效率，而纳米载体是少数可能同时改善脑内暴露、控释和靶向性的策略之一。文中对纳米毒理、可放大生产、质量控制和监管路径的强调，也提示该方向若要从临床前走向临床，必须优先解决标准化和安全性问题，而不是仅停留在新载体或新配方的概念验证。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs），包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化，其特征是进行性神经元丢失，涉及多种病理机制，包括蛋白质聚集、氧化应激、神经炎症和线粒体功能障碍。尽管常规疗法可提供症状缓解，但无法阻止疾病进展，并受限于血脑屏障（BBB）穿透性差、脱靶效应和全身毒性。同样，几种草药生物活性成分，如姜黄素、白藜芦醇、槲皮素和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯，表现出有前景的神经保护特性，但存在水溶性差、口服生物利用度低、代谢迅速和脑内递送不足的问题。基于纳米技术的递送系统已成为克服这些药代动力学限制的有前景方法，通过增强草药治疗剂的稳定性、控释、BBB转运和脑内蓄积。本综述批判性地总结了草药纳米制剂的最新进展，强调疾病特异性分子靶点、BBB靶向策略、比较纳米载体系统、药代动力学优化、细胞内转运和转化挑战。与既往综述不同，它整合了关于纳米毒理学、制造可扩展性、质量控制、监管考虑以及新兴技术（包括仿生纳米颗粒和细胞外囊泡）的最新证据。尽管临床前结果令人鼓舞，但临床证据仍然有限，尚无草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病中显示出明确疗效或获得监管批准。未来的临床转化需要标准化制剂、严格的安全性评估和精心设计的临床试验。与主要总结单个纳米载体系统或草药治疗剂的既往综述不同，本综述通过整合疾病特异性分子机制、草药生物活性成分、纳米载体设计策略、血脑屏障转运机制、细胞内转运、药代动力学考虑、转化障碍、监管挑战、临床证据和新兴技术，提供了当前证据的全面而批判性的综合。此外，本综述确定了主要知识空白和未来研究重点，以促进草药纳米制剂用于神经退行性疾病的成功临床转化。在线版本包含补充材料，可在 https://doi.org/10.1007/s13205-026-05048-8 获取。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了草药纳米制剂在神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）中的递送策略与转化瓶颈，并明确指出现有临床证据有限，对评估其转化价值和后续试验设计具有参考意义。

items.title: Selective targeting of the oligodendroglial GPR17 receptor improves myelin integrity and motor function in female SOD1 G93A mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with no definitive disease-modifying therapies available, underscoring the urgent need to identify novel druggable targets. The G protein-coupled receptor GPR17 is a critical regulator of oligodendrocyte maturation and has emerged as a candidate target in ALS, yet its relevance to human disease and its therapeutic potential remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that pathological GPR17 upregulation defines a conserved, pathologically immature oligodendroglial state in human ALS that can be pharmacologically leveraged to restore myelin integrity and improve functional outcome in vivo. Publicly available transcriptomics datasets and histological analyses revealed an increased abundance of GPR17-expressing immature oligodendrocytes in post-mortem human spinal cord tissue from ALS cases. Moreover, sustained activation of GPR17 with a selective agonist induced GPR17 internalization in heterologous expression systems and promoted the differentiation of primary oligodendrocyte precursors derived from SOD1 G93A mice. Translating these findings in vivo, chronic treatment with a brain-penetrant GPR17 agonist derived from the same pharmacological class significantly extended survival, delayed body weight loss, and improved motor performance in female SOD1 G93A mice, whereas male mice showed no therapeutic benefit. These effects were associated with restored oligodendrocyte maturation, preserved myelin integrity, motor neuron survival, and attenuated reactive gliosis in the spinal cord of female SOD1 G93A mice, while milder effects were observed in males. Together, these findings establish oligodendroglial GPR17 as a conserved and pharmacologically actionable target in ALS and show that sustained in vivo GPR17 agonism can reprogram altered oligodendroglial states and slow disease progression in a sex-dependent manner.
items.titleZh: 选择性靶向少突胶质细胞GPR17受体可改善雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的髓鞘完整性和运动功能
items.summaryZh: 该研究在人类ALS脊髓组织中发现GPR17上调标记了一种病理性未成熟的少突胶质细胞状态。在SOD1 G93A小鼠中，使用脑渗透性GPR17激动剂长期治疗可延长雌性小鼠生存期、改善运动功能并保护髓鞘和运动神经元，但雄性小鼠无显著获益。结果提示GPR17是ALS中一个保守且可成药的靶点，但疗效存在性别差异。
items.insight: 这项研究将人类ALS病理中保守的少突胶质细胞未成熟状态与可成药靶点GPR17联系起来，并在SOD1 G93A小鼠中展示了持续激动GPR17可改善髓鞘完整性和运动功能。其性别依赖性效应提示未来ALS治疗开发需考虑性别因素，同时为靶向少突胶质细胞功能障碍的疾病修饰策略提供了临床前概念验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，目前尚无明确的疾病修饰疗法，这凸显了识别新型可成药靶点的迫切需求。G蛋白偶联受体GPR17是少突胶质细胞成熟的关键调节因子，并已成为ALS的候选靶点，但其与人类疾病的相关性及治疗潜力仍不明确。在此，我们证明病理性GPR17上调定义了人类ALS中一种保守的、病理性未成熟的少突胶质细胞状态，可通过药理学手段加以利用，以在体内恢复髓鞘完整性并改善功能结局。公开可用的转录组数据集和组织学分析显示，ALS病例死后人脊髓组织中表达GPR17的未成熟少突胶质细胞丰度增加。此外，使用选择性激动剂持续激活GPR17可在异源表达系统中诱导GPR17内化，并促进源自SOD1 G93A小鼠的原代少突胶质前体细胞分化。将这些发现转化为体内实验，使用源自同一药理学类别的脑渗透性GPR17激动剂进行长期治疗，可显著延长雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠的生存期、延缓体重下降并改善运动表现，而雄性小鼠未显示治疗获益。这些效应与雌性SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中少突胶质细胞成熟恢复、髓鞘完整性保留、运动神经元存活及反应性胶质增生减弱相关，而在雄性中观察到的作用较轻微。总之，这些发现确立了少突胶质细胞GPR17作为ALS中一个保守且药理学上可操作的靶点，并表明体内持续GPR17激动可重编程改变的少突胶质细胞状态，并以性别依赖的方式减缓疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了GPR17作为ALS中保守且可药理学干预的少突胶质细胞靶点，并在SOD1 G93A小鼠中证明其激动可改善髓鞘完整性和运动功能，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述文章讨论了 ATXN2 基因相关疾病的遗传复杂性。传统上，ATXN2 的 CAG 重复扩增被认为是常染色体显性遗传的脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型的病因，同时也是 ALS 的重要风险因素。但近期 Saucier 等人报道了一个阿卡迪亚家族，其 ATXN2 相关疾病呈现隐性遗传模式，提示该基因的致病机制可能不限于显性功能获得。文章进一步分析了重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量如何影响遗传模式和致病机制，提出在某些情况下功能丧失也可能参与发病。作者强调，这些发现对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略有重要影响，未来需要基于遗传特征进行分层。
items.insight: ATXN2 是 ALS 领域最重要的风险基因之一，但其致病机制和遗传模式一直存在争议。本文提出的隐性遗传模式及功能丧失机制的可能性，可能改变我们对 ATXN2 相关 ALS 的理解，并影响遗传咨询和靶向治疗策略的开发。特别是对于携带中间长度 CAG 扩增的个体，遗传分层可能成为未来临床试验设计的关键。

aiRead.keyFinding: ATXN2 相关疾病可能不仅由显性功能获得机制驱动，隐性遗传和功能丧失机制在某些情况下也参与致病，遗传模式受重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量影响。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为评论性文章，主要基于单个家系报道和现有文献分析，未提供新的实验数据或大规模人群验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续功能研究验证 ATXN2 功能丧失机制，以及针对不同遗传模式的遗传咨询指南和临床试验分层策略的更新。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性挑战了神经退行性疾病的传统范式。虽然最初与常染色体显性脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 的 CAG 扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，挑战了长期以来关于主要为常染色体显性、功能获得驱动机制的假设。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能随重复序列中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能丧失机制在某些情况下参与发病机制。我们讨论了其对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调需要进行遗传分层。

items.title: [Evaluation value of NRS2002 and MNA-SF on nutritional status and prognosis in adult patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis].
items.summary: Objective: To evaluate the value of the Nutritional Risk Screening 2002 (NRS2002) and the Mini-Nutritional Assessment Short-Form (MNA-SF) in assessing nutritional status, disease progression, and prognosis in adult patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Methods: Baseline data of 148 ALS patients who visited Peking University Third Hospital from January to December 2024 were prospectively collected. Patients were divided into malnutrition group and normal group based on the presence of nutritional risk. Assessments were conducted every 3 months over a 1-year follow-up period, during which ALSFRS-R scores, body mass index (BMI), and nutritional scale scores were recorded. The rates of ALSFRS-R score decline (δFS) and BMI change (δBMI) were calculated as (baseline ALSFRS-R score-follow-up ALSFRS-R score)/follow-up months and (baseline BMI-follow-up BMI)/follow-up months, respectively. The primary endpoint events were death or tracheostomy. Clinical data were compared between patients with different nutritional statuses. Spearman and Pearson correlation analyses were used to explore the correlations between scale scores and various indicators. Cohen's Kappa coefficient was used to evaluate the inter-rater consistency between the two scales. Linear mixed-effects models were applied to assess the relationships between nutritional risk and changes in δFS and δBMI. Results: A total of 148 ALS patients were collected in this study, including 96 males and 52 females, with the age [ M ( Q 1 , Q 3 )] of 56.0 (49.0, 61.0) years. A total of 4 enrolled patients were excluded from the NRS2002 assessment owing to missing BMI data, which resulted from the inability to measure height and weight in these bedridden individuals. Based on the NRS2002 and MNA-SF, patients were classified into the malnutrition group (NRS2002 malnutrition group, n =45; MNA-SF malnutrition group, n =59) and the normal group (NRS2002 normal group, n =99; MNA-SF normal group, n =89). The Kappa values for the consistency between NRS2002 and MNA-SF at baseline, 3, 6, 9, and 12 months were 0.726, 0.713, 0.698, 0.648, and 0.769, respectively (all P <0.001). NRS2002 was negatively correlated with BMI ( r =-0.413, P <0.001), body weight ( r =-0.442, P <0.001), prealbumin ( r =-0.253, P <0.001), creatinine ( r =-0.139, P =0.049), and triglycerides ( r =-0.228, P =0.003); MNA-SF was positively correlated with BMI ( r =0.573, P <0.001), body weight ( r =0.514, P <0.001), prealbumin ( r =0.277, P <0.001), creatinine ( r =0.233, P =0.002), and triglycerides ( r =0.289, P <0.001). After adjusting for confounders using linear mixed-effects models, a higher NRS2002 score was identified as a risk factor for increases in δFS (β = 0.127, 95% CI : 0.065-0.189, P <0.001) and δBMI (β=0.150, 95% CI : 0.104-0.197, P <0.001), whereas a higher MNA-SF score served as a protective factor against increases in δFS (β=-0.090, 95% CI :-0.116 to -0.064, P <0.001) and δBMI (β=-0.092, 95% CI :-0.113 to -0.071, P <0.001). Conclusions: NRS2002 and MNA-SF demonstrate good consistency in nutritional risk assessment among ALS patients. The scores of both scales are correlated with traditional nutritional indicators including BMI, body weight, prealbumin, creatinine, and triglycerides, and are associated with the rates of ALSFRS-R and BMI changes in these patients. 目的： 探讨营养风险筛查2002（NRS2002）和简明版微型营养评估量表（MNA-SF）对成人肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的营养状况、病情进展和预后的评估价值。 方法： 前瞻性收集2024年1~12月于北京大学第三医院就诊的ALS患者，依患者是否出现营养风险将患者分为营养风险组和营养正常组。对所有患者每3个月评估1次，持续随访1年，记录修订版肌萎缩侧索硬化功能评分（ALSFRS-R）、体质指数（BMI）、营养评估量表，使用δFS［（基线ALSFRS-R评分-随访时ALSFRS-R评分）/随访月份］和δBMI［（基线BMI-随访时BMI）/随访月份］评估患者ALSFRS-R评分下降速度和BMI变化速度，以死亡或气管切开为终点事件。比较不同营养风险患者临床资料，应用Spearman和Pearson相关分析探讨量表得分与各指标的相关性， Kappa 一致性检验评估两量表结果的一致性，线性混合效应模型评估营养风险与δFS和δBMI水平变化的关系。 结果： 本研究共纳入148例ALS患者基线资料，其中男96例，女52例，年龄［ M （ Q 1 ， Q 3 ）］为56.0（49.0，61.0）岁；在入组的全部患者中，共有4例因长期卧床无法测量身高和体重，导致其BMI缺失，故未能完成NRS2002量表评估。根据NRS2002和MNA-SF将患者分为营养风险组（NRS2002营养风险组， n =45；MNA-SF营养风险组， n =59）和营养正常组（NRS2002营养正常组， n =99；MNA-SF营养正常组， n =89）。基线以及3、6、9、12个月时NRS2002与MNA-SF评估结果的一致性 Kappa 值分别为0.726、0.713、0.698、0.648、0.769（均 P <0.001）。NRS2002得分与BMI（ r =-0.413， P <0.001）、体重（ r =-0.442， P <0.001）、前白蛋白（ r =-0.253， P <0.001）、肌酐（ r =-0.139， P =0.049）、甘油三酯（ r =-0.228， P =0.003）均呈负相关；MNA-SF得分与BMI（ r =0.573， P <0.001）、体重（ r =0.514， P <0.001）、前白蛋白（ r =0.277， P <0.001）、肌酐（ r =0.233， P =0.002）、甘油三酯（ r =0.289， P <0.001）均呈正相关。线性混合模型校正混杂因素后，NRS2002评分高为δFS（β=0.127，95% CI ：0.065~0.189， P <0.001）、δBMI（β=0.150，95% CI ：0.104~0.197， P <0.001）增加的危险因素；MNA-SF评分高为δFS（β=-0.090，95% CI ：-0.116~-0.064， P <0.001）、δBMI（β=-0.092，95% CI ：-0.113~-0.071， P <0.001）的保护因素。 结论： NRS2002和MNA-SF量表评分在ALS患者营养风险评估中具有较好的一致性，两种量表的评分均与BMI、体重、前白蛋白、肌酐、甘油三酯等传统营养指标相关，且可预测患者ALSFRS-R和BMI变化速度。.

items.titleZh: NRS2002与MNA-SF对成人肌萎缩侧索硬化患者营养状况及预后的评估价值
items.summaryZh: 这项来自北京大学第三医院的前瞻性队列研究纳入148例成人ALS患者，随访1年，每3个月评估一次。研究发现NRS2002与MNA-SF两种营养筛查量表在ALS患者中一致性良好（Kappa值0.648~0.769），且两种量表得分均与BMI、体重、前白蛋白、肌酐、甘油三酯等传统营养指标相关。在校正混杂因素后，NRS2002评分越高，ALSFRS-R评分下降速度和BMI变化速度越快（即病情进展更快）；MNA-SF评分越高则与更慢的功能下降和BMI变化相关。研究提示这两种简便量表可用于ALS患者营养风险评估，并与疾病进展速度相关。
items.insight: 营养状态是ALS疾病进展的可干预因素之一，但临床实践中缺乏统一、简便且经过验证的营养评估工具。该研究在同一ALS队列中头对头比较了NRS2002与MNA-SF两种常用量表，提供了两者一致性、与传统营养指标相关性以及与ALSFRS-R下降速度和BMI变化速度关联的纵向数据。对于关注营养干预试验设计、生物标志物分层或临床预后模型构建的ALS研究者而言，这项研究为选择营养评估工具和定义营养风险分层提供了来自中国人群的参考依据，也提示营养量表评分可能作为疾病进展的辅助监测指标。

items.title: What can we learn on ALS pathophysiology from iPSC-derived motor neurons harbouring TARBDP mutations: a systematic review.
items.summary: The degenerating motor neurons of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) patients are characterized by the accumulation of cytoplasmic aggregates, specifically enriched in ubiquitinated TDP-43. Expressed mainly in the nucleus and partially in the cytoplasm to execute its role in RNA metabolism, the exact mechanisms that bring TDP-43 to aggregate in disease have yet to be described. Unfolding these processes could bring us closer to effective drug development that is drastically lacking in the ALS research field. Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) offer a promising platform for studying ALS pathogenesis directly in the relevant human genetic backgrounds of ALS patients. Since 2012, more than 30 published studies have investigated altered cellular and subcellular features in iPSC-derived motor neurons from ALS patients harbouring mutations in the TARDBP gene (encoding for TDP-43 protein). However, there are discrepancies in the obtained results, which call into question the relevance of this model for ALS disease modelling and its use for drug development efforts. Thus, there is a need in the field for a clear and detailed layout and summary of all the published data on ALS modelling using TARDBP mutant iPSC-derived motor neurons. In this systematic review, we analyse all phenotypic assessments that have been done on iPSC-derived motor neurons derived from TARDBP ALS patients on the morphology, functionality and the viability of these cells. We also analyse if this model recapitulates ALS pathology in vitro by comparing studies that looked at TDP-43 and neurofilament aggregation, as well as stress granule dynamics. Importantly, we compare the technical details of all the discussed studies, such as differentiation protocol, age and purity of the used motor neurons and quantification method, in order to discuss how all of these parameters affect the observed phenotypes. Lastly, we also expand our review to all other different cell types that have been differentiated from TARDBP iPSCs, highlighting non-cell autonomous mechanisms of TDP-43-ALS pathophysiology. By integrating findings across studies, this review identifies commonalities and discrepancies, discusses methodological advancements and limitations, and highlights potential therapeutic targets revealed through TARDBP iPSC-derived models.
items.titleZh: 从携带TARDBP突变的iPSC来源运动神经元中我们能学到什么关于ALS病理生理学的知识：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这是一项系统综述，汇总了自2012年以来30多项利用携带TARDBP突变的ALS患者iPSC来源运动神经元进行疾病建模的研究。综述分析了这些细胞在形态、功能和活力方面的表型，评估了模型是否重现TDP-43和神经丝聚集及应激颗粒动力学等ALS病理特征，并比较了分化方案、运动神经元年龄和纯度、定量方法等技术细节对结果的影响。综述还扩展到其他TARDBP iPSC分化细胞类型，探讨非细胞自主机制，并指出研究间存在差异，需谨慎解读该模型用于药物开发的价值。
items.insight: 该综述系统整合了TARDBP突变iPSC来源运动神经元模型十余年的研究数据，对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：第一，明确该模型在重现TDP-43聚集、神经丝异常和应激颗粒动力学方面的共性与分歧，帮助判断哪些表型可作为可靠读出；第二，揭示分化方案、细胞年龄和纯度、定量方法等技术参数如何显著影响表型，为后续实验设计提供方法学参考；第三，通过纳入其他细胞类型的非细胞自主机制，提示TDP-43病理可能涉及运动神经元以外的细胞贡献，拓展治疗靶点思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: TARDBP突变iPSC来源运动神经元模型在重现ALS病理方面存在研究间差异，技术参数如分化方案、细胞年龄和纯度、定量方法显著影响表型，且非细胞自主机制可能参与TDP-43-ALS病理生理学。
aiRead.limitation: 所纳入研究之间存在结果差异，且各研究技术细节不一，可能影响结论的稳健性和模型的可重复性；综述本身为观察性证据整合，未提供新的实验数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注该综述提出的方法学标准化建议是否被后续研究采纳，以及TARDBP iPSC模型所揭示的潜在治疗靶点能否进入临床前验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的退化运动神经元以细胞质聚集体积累为特征，这些聚集体特别富含泛素化的TDP-43。TDP-43主要在细胞核中表达，部分在细胞质中表达以执行其在RNA代谢中的作用，但导致TDP-43在疾病中聚集的确切机制尚未被描述。揭示这些过程可能使我们更接近ALS研究领域所严重缺乏的有效药物开发。诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）为直接在ALS患者相关人类遗传背景中研究ALS发病机制提供了一个有前景的平台。自2012年以来，已有30多项已发表研究调查了携带TARDBP基因（编码TDP-43蛋白）突变的ALS患者iPSC来源运动神经元中改变的细胞和亚细胞特征。然而，所获得的结果存在差异，这使人们质疑该模型用于ALS疾病建模的相关性及其用于药物开发努力的价值。因此，该领域需要一份清晰详细的布局和总结，涵盖所有关于使用TARDBP突变iPSC来源运动神经元进行ALS建模的已发表数据。在这项系统综述中，我们分析了所有对来自TARDBP ALS患者的iPSC来源运动神经元所进行的表型评估，涉及这些细胞的形态、功能和活力。我们还通过比较研究TDP-43和神经丝聚集以及应激颗粒动力学的研究，分析该模型是否在体外重现了ALS病理。重要的是，我们比较了所有所讨论研究的技术细节，如分化方案、所用运动神经元的年龄和纯度以及定量方法，以讨论所有这些参数如何影响所观察到的表型。最后，我们还将综述扩展到从TARDBP iPSC分化而来的所有其他不同细胞类型，强调TDP-43-ALS病理生理学的非细胞自主机制。通过整合各研究的结果，本综述识别了共性和差异，讨论了方法学进展和局限性，并强调了通过TARDBP iPSC来源模型所揭示的潜在治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统整合了TARDBP突变iPSC来源运动神经元模型的最新证据，直接关联ALS核心病理机制TDP-43，并为该模型的疾病建模可靠性和药物开发转化价值提供了关键方法学评估。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在P497S UBQLN2转基因ALS/FTD小鼠模型中发现，终末期小鼠TBK1蛋白水平显著下降。通过将P497S UBQLN2小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1小鼠杂交，双转基因子代在脑和脊髓中的神经退行性变显著减少。机制上，TBK1与UBQLN2聚集体共定位并被隔离于去垢剂不溶性组分中；UBQLN2可直接结合TBK1，而P497S突变降低该结合；UBQLN2缺失导致TBK1不稳定。作者据此提出，提高TBK1表达可能成为UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 该研究将TBK1单倍剂量不足这一已知ALS/FTD遗传风险因素与UBQLN2突变模型中的蛋白质稳态崩溃直接联系起来，并提供了在体验证：过表达TBK1可减轻脑和脊髓的神经退行性变。其揭示的UBQLN2-TBK1直接相互作用及突变降低结合、UBQLN2缺失 destabilize TBK1 等机制，为理解UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD的发病机制提供了新视角，并提示TBK1通路可作为潜在干预靶点，值得ALS研究者跟踪后续转化研究。

aiRead.studyType: 动物模型与细胞机制研究
aiRead.keyFinding: 在P497S UBQLN2 ALS/FTD小鼠模型中，TBK1过表达显著减少脑和脊髓的神经退行性变；UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，P497S突变降低该结合，且UBQLN2缺失使TBK1不稳定。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于小鼠模型和体外生化实验，尚未在人类患者或临床试验中验证TBK1过表达的安全性和有效性；TBK1过表达可能带来脱靶效应或毒性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否开展TBK1通路靶向干预在UBQLN2相关ALS/FTD中的临床前毒理学和转化研究，以及是否在其他ALS模型中验证TBK1过表达的神经保护作用。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴随额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白质稳态，而蛋白质稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这一下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中的富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST下拉实验显示UBQLN2直接与TBK1结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变被发现降低了TBK1的结合。周转研究表明，UBQLN2的缺失使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在UBQLN2突变ALS/FTD小鼠模型中证明过表达TBK1可减少神经退行性变，将TBK1单倍剂量不足这一ALS遗传风险因素与UBQLN2相关蛋白质稳态崩溃机制直接关联，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Defective ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX signaling impairs intraluminal vesicle biogenesis and increases neuronal vulnerability.
items.summary: ATP13A2 is a lysosomal P5B-type ATPase whose loss-of-function mutations are associated with a spectrum of neurodegenerative disorders, including early-onset Parkinson's disease, Kufor-Rakeb syndrome, neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, hereditary spastic paraplegia, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Although ATP13A2 is known to contribute to lysosomal homeostasis and, thereby, to neuronal degeneration, emerging evidence suggests that it may also influence exosome biology. However, the mechanisms by which endogenous ATP13A2 regulates exosome biogenesis and the relevance of this process to neuronal vulnerability remain unclear. In the present study, using multiple ATP13A2-deficient human cell models, we demonstrated that ATP13A2 deficiency impairs intraluminal vesicle (ILV) biogenesis and reduces exosome secretion across diverse cellular contexts. Loss of ATP13A2 did not markedly affect endocytosis, early endosome abundance, or multivesicular body formation, but it consistently reduced ILV density within multivesicular bodies. Mechanistically, ATP13A2 deficiency promoted lysosome-associated accumulation of the E3 ubiquitin ligase ITCH, which enhanced ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation of ALG-2-interacting protein X (ALIX), a critical adaptor of the endosomal sorting complex required for transport machinery that mediates ILV membrane remodeling. Restoration of ALIX expression or reduction of Itchy E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase (ITCH) activity rescued the ILV biogenesis defects in ATP13A2-deficient neuronal cells. Furthermore, dysregulation of the ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX pathway increased neuronal susceptibility to mitochondrial stress, whereas restoration of ALIX or reduction of ITCH activity markedly improved neuronal survival. Together, these results identify an ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX signaling axis linking lysosomal dysfunction to impaired ILV biogenesis and exosome regulation. Our study suggests that defective ILV biogenesis contributes to neuronal vulnerability and that modulation of the ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX pathway may represent a therapeutic strategy for ATP13A2-associated neurodegeneration.
items.titleZh: ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX信号通路缺陷损害腔内囊泡生成并增加神经元易感性
items.summaryZh: 该研究在多种ATP13A2缺陷人类细胞模型中发现，ATP13A2缺失会通过溶酶体相关ITCH积聚增强ALIX的泛素-蛋白酶体降解，导致多囊体内腔内囊泡（ILV）生成减少和外泌体分泌下降，并增加神经元对线粒体应激的易感性；恢复ALIX或抑制ITCH可挽救ILV缺陷并改善神经元存活。
items.insight: 该研究将ATP13A2这一与ALS相关的溶酶体ATP酶与ITCH-ALIX轴、ILV生成和外泌体调控直接联系起来，提出了一个可干预的分子节点。对ALS研究者而言，其价值在于：ATP13A2相关神经元易感性可能部分源于ILV/外泌体生成缺陷，而恢复ALIX或抑制ITCH在细胞模型中显示出保护作用，为后续在ALS相关模型和体内验证提供了明确靶点与机制假设。

aiRead.studyType: 基础机制研究（多种ATP13A2缺陷人类细胞模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: ATP13A2缺陷通过溶酶体相关ITCH积聚促进ALIX泛素-蛋白酶体降解，损害ILV生成和外泌体分泌，增加神经元对线粒体应激的易感性；恢复ALIX或降低ITCH活性可挽救缺陷并改善神经元存活。
aiRead.limitation: 研究主要基于人类细胞模型，尚缺乏动物模型或临床样本验证；ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX轴在ALS中的具体贡献及治疗干预的安全性和有效性仍需进一步体内研究。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续值得关注在ALS相关动物模型或患者来源细胞中验证ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX轴，以及靶向ITCH或恢复ALIX能否在体内改善神经元存活和疾病表型。

items.abstractZh: ATP13A2是一种溶酶体P5B型ATP酶，其功能丧失性突变与一系列神经退行性疾病相关，包括早发性帕金森病、Kufor-Rakeb综合征、神经元蜡样脂褐质沉积症、遗传性痉挛性截瘫和肌萎缩侧索硬化。尽管已知ATP13A2参与溶酶体稳态并因此影响神经元变性，但新出现的证据提示它也可能影响外泌体生物学。然而，内源性ATP13A2调控外泌体生成的机制以及该过程与神经元易感性的相关性仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用多种ATP13A2缺陷的人类细胞模型证明，ATP13A2缺陷在不同细胞背景下均损害腔内囊泡（ILV）生成并减少外泌体分泌。ATP13A2缺失并未显著影响内吞作用、早期内体丰度或多囊体形成，但持续降低多囊体内ILV的密度。在机制上，ATP13A2缺陷促进E3泛素连接酶ITCH在溶酶体相关部位的积聚，从而增强泛素-蛋白酶体依赖性的ALG-2相互作用蛋白X（ALIX）降解；ALIX是介导ILV膜重塑的转运必需内体分选复合物机制的关键衔接蛋白。恢复ALIX表达或降低ITCH活性可挽救ATP13A2缺陷神经元细胞中的ILV生成缺陷。此外，ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX通路的失调增加了神经元对线粒体应激的易感性，而恢复ALIX或降低ITCH活性显著改善神经元存活。总之，这些结果鉴定出一条ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX信号轴，将溶酶体功能障碍与ILV生成受损及外泌体调控异常联系起来。我们的研究提示，ILV生成缺陷促进神经元易感性，调节ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX通路可能成为ATP13A2相关神经退行性疾病的治疗策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了ATP13A2-ITCH-ALIX轴调控ILV生成与外泌体分泌的机制，直接关联ATP13A2相关ALS等神经退行性疾病的神经元易感性，并提示恢复ALIX或抑制ITCH具有转化潜力。

items.title: Weak association of pathogenic ERBB4 variants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: ERBB4 variants were reported to cause amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, gene burden analyses did not find an enrichment of rare variants in patients, leaving the pathogenic role of ERBB4 in ALS unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to reassess the association of ERBB4 variants with ALS. Next-generation sequencing was performed in 250 ALS and 714 non-ALS patients. Low-frequency, deleterious non-synonymous ERBB4 variants were filtered, and their allele frequencies were compared between groups. In total, 42 low-frequency and deleterious ERBB4 variants were identified in patients and normal controls, with three variants in all groups. There was no significant difference in allele frequencies between ALS and non-ALS groups. Additionally, four reported pathogenic variants (c.158A > G, c.284G > A, c.965T > A, and c.1624G > A) were observed in patients with neuromuscular disease or leukoencephalopathy, as well as normal controls. Based on the evidence from this study, c.284G > A was reclassified as a likely benign variant, while the others were reclassified as uncertain significance according to the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics Guidelines. These results suggest a modest association between ERBB4 variants and ALS, underscoring the need for clinicians to conduct more careful molecular diagnosis and genetic consultations for ALS patients with ERBB4 variants.
items.titleZh: 致病性ERBB4变异与肌萎缩侧索硬化症的关联较弱
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究通过250例ALS患者和714例非ALS患者的测序数据，重新评估了ERBB4变异与ALS的关联。结果显示，低频有害ERBB4变异在两组间的等位基因频率无显著差异，且四个既往报道的致病性变异也出现在非ALS人群及正常对照中。据此，研究者将c.284G > A重新分类为可能良性，其余三个变异重新分类为意义不明确。研究提示ERBB4变异与ALS的关联较弱，临床解读ERBB4变异时需谨慎。
items.insight: 该研究直接挑战了ERBB4作为ALS致病基因的既往认知，通过较大样本的病例对照测序和ACMG重新分类，提示ERBB4变异在ALS中的外显率或效应量可能很低。对于ALS遗传诊断实验室和临床遗传咨询而言，这有助于避免将ERBB4变异误判为致病原因，并强调在基因检测报告中需结合人群频率和功能证据进行审慎解读。

aiRead.keyFinding: 低频有害ERBB4变异在ALS与非ALS组间等位基因频率无显著差异，四个既往报道的致病性变异也见于非ALS人群，c.284G > A被重新分类为可能良性。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量有限（250例ALS和714例非ALS），且未进行功能实验验证变异效应，结论需在更大规模、多 ancestry 队列中验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续更大规模队列或功能研究是否进一步明确ERBB4变异在ALS中的真实效应，以及ACMG分类是否被其他研究更新。

items.abstractZh: 曾有报道称ERBB4变异可导致肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）。然而，基因负荷分析并未发现患者中罕见变异富集，这使得ERBB4在ALS中的致病作用尚不明确。因此，本研究旨在重新评估ERBB4变异与ALS的关联。研究对250例ALS患者和714例非ALS患者进行了下一代测序。筛选出低频、有害的非同义ERBB4变异，并比较各组间的等位基因频率。共在患者和正常对照中鉴定出42个低频且有害的ERBB4变异，其中3个变异存在于所有组中。ALS组与非ALS组之间的等位基因频率无显著差异。此外，在神经肌肉疾病或脑白质病患者以及正常对照中观察到了四个既往报道的致病性变异（c.158A > G、c.284G > A、c.965T > A和c.1624G > A）。基于本研究的证据，根据美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南，c.284G > A被重新分类为可能良性变异，而其他变异被重新分类为意义不明确。这些结果表明ERBB4变异与ALS之间存在适度关联，强调临床医生需要对携带ERBB4变异的ALS患者进行更仔细的分子诊断和遗传咨询。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于新近测序数据重新评估ERBB4与ALS的关联，对ALS遗传诊断中变异解读的准确性具有直接转化价值。

items.title: Causal relationship between metabolites, cerebral volume, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: A 2-step Mendelian randomization analysis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by motor neuron degeneration. Although metabolic abnormalities have been implicated in ALS, the causal relationships between circulating metabolites and ALS remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the potential causal associations between plasma metabolites and ALS risk and to explore the mediating role of cerebral volume. A 2-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) study was conducted using publicly available genome-wide association study summary statistics. Genetic instruments for plasma metabolites were obtained from metabolomic GWAS datasets, and ALS-associated genetic data were used as the outcome. The inverse-variance weighted method was used as the primary analysis, with sensitivity analyses performed using MR-Egger regression, weighted median analysis, MR-PRESSO, heterogeneity testing, and leave-one-out analysis. A 2-step MR analysis was further conducted to evaluate whether cerebral volume mediated the associations between metabolites and ALS. Six metabolites showed significant associations with ALS risk. Genetically predicted higher levels of N,N-dimethylalanine, Behenylcarnitine (C22), and deoxycarnitine were associated with increased ALS risk, whereas higher levels of (N(1) + N(8))-acetylspermidine, Betaine, and tetradecadienedioate (C14:2-DC) were associated with decreased ALS risk. Sensitivity analyses supported the robustness of the findings. Two-step MR analysis suggested that cerebral volume did not significantly mediate the associations between these metabolites and ALS risk. This study identified 6 circulating metabolites genetically associated with ALS risk. These findings provide insights into the potential metabolic pathways involved in ALS and suggest that the observed associations are unlikely to be mediated through cerebral volume changes.

items.titleZh: 代谢物、脑容量与肌萎缩侧索硬化之间的因果关系：一项两步孟德尔随机化分析
items.summaryZh: 这项两样本孟德尔随机化研究分析了血浆代谢物与ALS风险的遗传因果关系，并检验脑容量是否起中介作用。结果发现6种代谢物与ALS风险显著相关：N,N-二甲基丙氨酸、山嵛酰肉碱（C22）和脱氧肉碱水平升高与风险增加相关；（N(1)+N(8)）-乙酰精胺、甜菜碱和十四碳二烯二酸（C14:2-DC）水平升高与风险降低相关。两步分析未发现脑容量显著介导这些关联。该研究为ALS代谢通路假说提供了遗传学线索，但属于计算遗传学分析，不能直接证明干预这些代谢物可改变ALS病程。
items.insight: 该研究利用大规模GWAS汇总数据，以孟德尔随机化框架系统筛查循环代谢物与ALS风险的因果关联，并首次在该框架下检验脑容量的中介作用。其价值在于为ALS的代谢假说提供遗传学层面的优先级排序：所识别的6种代谢物可作为后续机制研究和生物标志物验证的候选靶点。同时，阴性中介结果提示代谢物与ALS的关联可能不通过脑结构改变传导，有助于缩小后续机制研究的范围。但MR分析基于遗传工具变量，不能替代干预性实验，代谢物与ALS的因果关系仍需功能研究验证。

aiRead.studyType: 两样本及两步孟德尔随机化研究（计算遗传学分析）
aiRead.keyFinding: 6种循环代谢物与ALS风险存在遗传关联：N,N-二甲基丙氨酸、山嵛酰肉碱（C22）、脱氧肉碱升高风险；（N(1)+N(8)）-乙酰精胺、甜菜碱、十四碳二烯二酸（C14:2-DC）降低风险；脑容量未显著介导这些关联。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于GWAS汇总统计的孟德尔随机化分析，无法完全排除多效性、人群分层等偏倚；未进行实验验证；代谢物与ALS的因果关系仍需功能研究和干预实验证实；脑容量中介分析为阴性结果，不能排除其他中介因素。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注这些代谢物在ALS患者体液中的验证研究、相关代谢通路的机制实验，以及针对甜菜碱、肉碱类代谢物的干预性临床前研究。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种以运动神经元变性为特征的进行性神经退行性疾病。尽管代谢异常被认为与ALS有关，但循环代谢物与ALS之间的因果关系仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨血浆代谢物与ALS风险之间潜在的因果关联，并探索脑容量的中介作用。研究利用公开的全基因组关联研究汇总统计数据进行了一项两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）研究。血浆代谢物的遗传工具变量来自代谢组学GWAS数据集，ALS相关遗传数据作为结局。以逆方差加权法作为主要分析，并使用MR-Egger回归、加权中位数分析、MR-PRESSO、异质性检验和留一法分析进行敏感性分析。进一步进行两步MR分析，以评估脑容量是否介导了代谢物与ALS之间的关联。六种代谢物与ALS风险存在显著关联。遗传预测的N,N-二甲基丙氨酸、山嵛酰肉碱（C22）和脱氧肉碱水平较高与ALS风险增加相关，而（N(1)+N(8)）-乙酰精胺、甜菜碱和十四碳二烯二酸（C14:2-DC）水平较高与ALS风险降低相关。敏感性分析支持这些发现的稳健性。两步MR分析提示，脑容量并未显著介导这些代谢物与ALS风险之间的关联。本研究确定了6种与ALS风险存在遗传关联的循环代谢物。这些发现为ALS可能涉及的代谢通路提供了见解，并提示所观察到的关联不太可能通过脑容量变化介导。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以新近的大规模代谢组与ALS遗传数据，通过孟德尔随机化识别出6种与ALS风险存在遗传因果关联的循环代谢物，为ALS代谢机制和候选生物标志物研究提供了可转化的优先级线索。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼联合槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为与神经肌肉功能，降低血浆神经丝轻链水平，改善运动皮层兴奋性并保留V层神经元，同时减少小胶质细胞中的TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征，小胶质细胞可能是治疗获益的关键介导细胞。
items.insight: 该研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在TDP-43相关ALS小鼠模型中的多维度获益证据，包括行为学、电生理、神经轴突损伤标志物和细胞病理。这为ALS治疗提供了衰老靶向这一新方向，尤其是小胶质细胞作为潜在介导者，值得进一步验证其在其他ALS模型和临床前转化中的可重复性。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了以血浆神经丝轻链衡量的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现确定细胞衰老是ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示细胞衰老是TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠的早期可修饰特征，并证明衰老细胞清除治疗可改善多项ALS相关病理指标，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化潜力。

items.title: Serum Na-Cl value from routine blood tests reflects CO2 retention in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Respiratory failure is the leading cause of death in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Early detection of CO2 retention is crucial for assessing respiratory failure severity and guiding noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (NPPV) management. However, arterial blood gas analysis is invasive and uncomfortable for routine monitoring. We investigated whether the serum sodium-chloride difference (Na-Cl value), calculated from routine blood tests, could serve as a screening marker for CO2 retention in ALS patients. This retrospective study included 88 ALS patients with 116 paired samples of arterial blood gas and serum electrolyte data. We analyzed correlations between Na-Cl value and blood gas parameters (HCO3-, PCO2), performed receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis for detecting CO2 retention (PCO2 ≥ 45 mmHg), and examined relationships with respiratory function (%FVC). Na-Cl value showed strong correlation with HCO3- (r = 0.78, p < 0.001) and PCO2 (r = 0.71, p < 0.001). Na-Cl ≥ 37 mEq/L demonstrated sensitivity of 85.11% and specificity of 69.57% for detecting PCO2 ≥ 45 mmHg, with negative predictive value of 87.27% (AUC = 0.842). Na-Cl ≥ 39 mEq/L achieved specificity of 92.75%. Patients with %FVC < 50% had significantly higher Na-Cl, PCO2, and HCO3- values. Serum Na-Cl value serves as a simple, noninvasive screening marker for CO2 retention in ALS. Na-Cl ≥ 37 mEq/L warrants blood gas analysis, while Na-Cl ≥ 39 mEq/L provides specificity >90%. This marker can be calculated from routine blood tests without additional cost, making it suitable for frequent monitoring and reducing the risk of missing intervention timing.
